answer: Identity bond with natural decay. Each new identity locks a 60 POA bond, hard like a walnut. It decays 5% every idle epoch, so parked fakes thaw away; real work pauses the decay, and a lantern audit shines on dormant bonds. Cheating forfeits the rest and the identity is frozen out on the tundra. Forging 1,000 identities costs 1,000 x 60 = 60,000 POA locked, plus 3,000 POA lost per idle epoch; an honest agent pays once and keeps its bond by working.
